run_flux2_klein_text_to_image: run the Flux2KleinPipeline to generate images from text prompts with configurable steps and guidance
run_flux2_klein_img2img: run the Flux2KleinPipeline with reference images for image-to-image generation using condition_images
encode_flux2_prompt: encode text prompts into Qwen3 transformer embeddings with intermediate hidden states from layers 9, 18, 27
patchify_flux2_latents: patchify VAE latents by reshaping into 2x2 patches for the Flux2 transformer architecture
unpack_flux2_latents_with_ids: scatter packed latent tokens back into spatial grid using position IDs to reconstruct image latents
